content:
amira_sales: Quick handoff — CrescentCare closed (Enterprise, Private VPC). Signed yesterday. Main asks: SSO (SAML), KMS integration, and a reserved dedicated pool for 3x PoC throughput. Target onboarding window: first week of next month. Renewal in ~11 months (annual). Noted churn risk: they saw latency during PoC at p50 ~400ms and were sensitive to token cost.

jordan_cs: Thanks @amira_sales — tagging owners and next steps. I can lead onboarding. Need full contract + SSO metadata + initial contact list for IT/security. Also want to set a 2-week pilot runbook then scale.

amira_sales: Contract link: https://drive.redwood/crescentcare/contract.pdf. Primary IT: maria.crescent@ccare.io, infra lead: tom@ccare.io. Pilot objectives: 1) SSO + test users 2) baseline perf at their expected seq_len 1024 3) cost telemetry for 2k req/day.

lee_se: I can own SSO/KMS config and perf tuning. Will validate model variant suggestions for latency/cost tradeoffs. Plan: create a staging Private deployment, run gradual load tests, capture KV cache hit rates.

sam_support: I'll open support tickets for provisioning + SSO certificate import. Also will prep a debug runbook for on-call if we see token-cost surprises.

amira_sales: They want an enablement session for their ML infra team during week 1. Also want a short eval template to track generation quality vs current prod.

jordan_cs: Action list so far: 
- Jordan: kickoff call + pilot plan + weekly feedback sheet.
- Lee: staging deploy + SAML metadata flow + perf tests.
- Sam: support tickets for VPC peering, KMS access, and dedicated pool.
- Amira: intro email + contract + PO details.

jordan_cs: Can we confirm onboarding kickoff Thu 09:30 PT? I can send invite and agenda.

amira_sales: Thu works for them. Please include an ops checklist and a short demo of latency/cost dashboards.

lee_se: Quick SAML snippet to validate metadata during handoff:```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://sso.crescentcare.io">
  <SPSSODescriptor>...metadata...</SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>```Run `openssl s_client -connect sso.crescentcare.io:443 -showcerts` to check cert chain.

sam_support: Tickets created: SUP-12489 (VPC/KMS), SUP-12490 (Dedicated pool provisioning), SUP-12491 (SSO onboarding). deploy-bot: created SUP-12489, SUP-12490, SUP-12491.

deploy-bot: Ticket SUP-12489 assigned to sam_support; SUP-12490 assigned to infra-provisioning; SUP-12491 assigned to identity-team.

jordan_cs: For feedback capture I'll make a shared sheet and a small eval harness. Link will be in the kickoff invite. We should collect: latency by route, cost per 1k tokens, quality diffs on 50 golden prompts, and any hallucination cases flagged.

amira_sales: FYI renewal owner is currently Sales (me) but we should flag renewal health early — add a renewal check-in at month 9. They indicated budget compression could be an issue if token costs run high.

lee_se: Perf plan: baseline tests at seq_len 512 and 1024, 1k req/day then 5k. Will collect token breakdown, KV hit rate, and p95 latency. If p95 > 800ms we iterate quantization/profile or switch to a lower-latency variant.

sam_support: Noted. I'll attach the SUP tickets to the customer record and add runbooks. Also will add escalation path: pager -> oncall infra -> eng-runtime if we hit provisioning errors.

jordan_cs: Final ask: include a single shared place for action owners. I'll create a tracker in the kickoff invite. Tentative owners: Jordan (CS) — overall onboarding, Lee (SE) — technical enablement & perf, Sam (Support) — provisioning & runbooks, Amira (Sales) — contract/PO/renewal.

amira_sales: Perfect. Thanks all. I'll send the intro + PO tonight. :thumbsup:

lee_se: I'll start staging deploy tomorrow and post results in the thread.

sam_support: I'll monitor tickets and ping here with updates.

jordan_cs: Great — see you on Thu 09:30 PT. Reminder: collect initial feedback weekly during pilot.

amira_sales: Closing note: flagging “cost sensitivity” and “SSO/certs” as the two biggest risk items. If either slips, escalate to account exec.
